summary_en: Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd. raised its tender offer price for Kakaku.com common stock from 3,571 yen to 3,680 yen per share, and extended the offer period to September 29, 2026 (95 business days total). The board and special committee confirmed their prior support but await response from a competing bidder regarding a potential price increase.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment Regarding Support Opinion and Recommendation for Tender Offer for Company Stock by Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
On September 10, 2026, Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd., the primary bidder for the acquisition of Kakaku.com, raised its tender offer price from 3,571 yen per share to 3,680 yen per share for common stock. The company also extended the offer period to September 29, 2026, making the total offer period 95 business days. This price increase follows multiple amendments to the original tender offer announced on May 12, 2026.

The board of directors and the special committee established to review the delisting transaction confirmed that their prior endorsement of the Kamgras 1 offer and recommendation for shareholders to tender remained unchanged as of September 11, 2026. However, the board and committee indicated they were seeking a written response from a competing bidder, BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. (sponsored by Bain Capital and involving LINE Yahoo Corporation), regarding its willingness to increase its competing offer price from 3,520 yen (or 3,640 yen if a non-tender agreement with KDDI is reached) per share. The board and committee stated they would conduct further good-faith negotiations with both bidders and proceed with careful deliberation.
